rules.title: Homebrew cache
rules.explanation: Packages already downloaded. Homebrew downloads them again when needed.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.explanation: Python packages already downloaded. pip downloads them again when needed.

rules.title: npm cache
rules.explanation: JavaScript packages already downloaded. npm downloads them again when needed.

rules.title: Old logs
rules.explanation: App log files untouched for over 30 days. They only help diagnose past problems.

rules.title: Brave cache
rules.explanation: Pages and images saved to open sites faster. It's recreated as you browse, and the first page loads will be slower. Doesn't touch history, passwords, or cookies.

rules.title: Chrome cache
rules.explanation: Pages and images saved to open sites faster. It's recreated as you browse, and the first page loads will be slower. Doesn't touch history, passwords, or cookies.

rules.title: Steam cache
rules.explanation: Temporary files of the Steam app. Doesn't contain games or saves. Recreated the next time it opens.

rules.title: Xcode build data
rules.explanation: The DerivedData folder. Xcode recreates it, but the next build of every project will be a full, slower one.

rules.title: iOS device support
rules.explanation: Debug files downloaded from connected iPhones and iPads. Xcode downloads them again the next time one connects, which can take a few minutes.

rules.title: Unavailable simulators
rules.explanation: Simulators for iOS versions that are no longer installed: they can't start.

rules.title: Data of all simulators
rules.explanation: Resets every simulator to its initial state: installed apps and their data, photos, and settings are lost. The simulators stay, and still take a few MB each.

rules.title: Old Homebrew versions
rules.explanation: Outdated versions of installed packages. Also deletes the Homebrew cache.
